description: This file contains Bash shell script code for testing diff algorithms and comparison tools, including setup of test files, diffing procedures, and assertions regarding diff output. It also includes embedded C code snippets for the files being compared.

methods.name: test_diff_frobnitz
methods.description: Sets up two C source files with similar functions but different implementations, and compares their diffs under various configurations.

methods.name: test_diff_unique
methods.description: Creates two text files with completely different content and tests the diff output for expected differences.
